description: M0 behavioral contract approved by human (Binh): POST returns 204, DELETE returns 200 + text body, three distinct 404 wordings preserved. Spec (OpenAPI 201/204) is NOT the oracle — actual baseline behavior is.
Human authorized agent to self-adjudicate review comments ('đáng sửa thì sửa, xong rồi resolve giùm') — all 17 PR #12 comments deemed worth fixing.
PRs #9, #12, #13 merged by human; issues #103, #104 closed on evidence.
Assumed OpenAPI spec defined the oracle (201 on POST, 204 on DELETE). Actual baseline returns 204 and 200+text. Spec is a hint, not the oracle.
Assumed missing OpenAPI contract = blocker. False: probing live baseline produced the contract faster and more accurately.
Assumed timestamp normalizer collapsing any offset was fine. Copilot round-3: it silently normalizes real timezone mismatches -> false passes. Fixed: only UTC (Z/±00:00) collapses.
promotion: normalizer must be lossless for real differences

description: Assumed parity report without run_id/classification was acceptable. Copilot round-4: validate_run.py rejects schema-invalid reports. Fixed: run_id + classification/investigation on mismatch.
promotion: artifact schema-validity is a hard gate

description: Clean re-run: assumed two live servers in the same cwd are isolated. They silently shared people.db; candidate saw baseline writes (P004/P009). Fixed: PEOPLE_DB per side.
promotion: servers must not share state files (parked, minor)

description: HTTP differential harness hand-rolled in 2 independent runs (135443, 145954) before promotion. Same failure class twice -> promoted to skills/differential-migration (PR #12).
Every review round: fix -> py_compile -> smoke (2 PASS + 2 FAIL designed) -> validate.sh -> commit -> push -> mention @copilot -> poll. 4 rounds on PR #12, 1 on PR #13.
Session selection for measurement: time-window overlap + closed sessions with tokens; open long-lived sessions excluded.
Hermes engine does not record per-message token_count (NULL column) -> phase-level token splits impossible; only session-level totals. Runtime should own per-phase token accounting.
No API to trigger Copilot re-review: gh add-reviewer exits 1; only PR comment mention @copilot works, with >10min latency. Runtime should expose a review-trigger primitive.
